newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land takes 30 pct of HK Conrad for HK$722 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land takes 30 pct of HK Conrad for HK$722 mln.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd said on Monday it would buy Conrad International Investment Corp's 30 percent interest in Greenroll Ltd, the owner of the Conrad Hotel in Hong Kong, for about HK$721.8 million.

Sino Hotels (Holdings) Ltd also said in a joint statement it will pay a further HK$128.91 million for a waiver of pre-emption rights and consents to sharholders of Greenroll Ltd regarding its deal to purchase the Conrad Hotel.
The money would be paid to the vendors, Pacific Electric Wire and Cable Co Ltd's Blinco Enterprises Ltd and Mersey Ltd, Conrad International, and Swire Pacific Ltd's Swire Properties Ltd, it said.
Tsim Sha Tsui Properties Ltd, the 60.1 percent parent of Sino Land, and Sino Hotels are both controlled by Singapore property tycoon Ng Teng Fong.
In November Sino Hotels reached a conditional agreement to buy 50 percent of Greenroll, which owns the Conrad Hotel in Hong Kong's Pacific Place, from Blinco and Mersey for about HK$1.07 billion.
The remaining 20 percent in Greenroll is owned by Swire Properties.
Sino Hotels said following the waiver the agreement became unconditional and a sum of HK$218.56 million had been paid to the sellers on January 25 with the balance to be paid by January 31, 1997.

SEA Holdings Ltd had announced in December it had reached an agreement to buy an 80 percent stake in Conrad Hotel for HK$1.85 billion from Conrad Intnernational, but withdrew from the deal earlier this month.
Conrad International had earlier said it would exercise its right of pre-emption to buy 50 percent of Greenroll from Pacific Electric Wire, bringing its stake in Conrad to 80 percent.
SEA did not give the reason why the deal was terminated.
Sino Land also said it will offer to sell its interest in hotels to Sino Hotels at an appropriate time.
